cands.name: Joe Pike
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 6. He first took office on January 1, 2023, and has won re-election since. He owns Twisted Grape Investments.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Joe Pike was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no details on his career beyond owning Twisted Grape Investments. We found no sponsored bills with described content, no documented actions or statements on the issues in this guide, no public stances on data centers or development, no endorsements, and no reported controversies. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022, 2024 or 2026, so there is no questionnaire to draw on.

cands.name: Tony Spears
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for North Carolina House District 6 in 2026, representing Harnett County. Former president of the Harnett County NAACP and served multiple terms as chair of the Harnett County Board of Elections, per his campaign site.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as endorsed by two voter-guide groups: Fair Map Fight Club and Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy (both Sway voting groups).

cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no paid career history beyond his NAACP and county elections board roles, and no dates for those roles. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. His campaign site does not address data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or campaign money, and we found no documented actions on those topics. We found no news coverage, controversies or foreign ties.
